jobs.description:
Research Program Coordinator (4800C), Department of Chemistry - #89543 About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
UC Berkeley was rated the number one public university in the US for 2026, with the Department of Chemistry rated the best program for chemistry in the world in 2023. Since 1946, UC Berkeley has won 19 Nobel Prizes for Chemistry, our most recent was awarded in 2025.
  
  
The Department of Chemistry is seeking a new Faculty Support Administrator to support our top-rated research. Our faculty address major scientific and technological challenges facing the world. Join us in our mission to advance society through education and research.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Research Program Coordinator provides administrative support and manages the general operations of the laboratories of Professors Tatyana Polenova and Ashok Ajoy, as well as the Pines Magnetic Resonance Center (PMRC). This position handles complex financial planning, contract and grant management, research support, center operations, and event management. The Research Program Coordinator functions with a high degree of autonomy in a fast-paced environment, seamlessly switching between projects and drawing on an advanced understanding of financial procedures in an academic setting.
  
  
Application Review Date
  
  
**The First Review Date for this job is:** October 30, 2026. For full consideration, please apply on or before November 4, 2026
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
PMRC Support - 30%
  
  
Administers PMRC and is primarily responsible for administrative academic or research and programmatic activities. Assists with research direction, events, and personnel support for specific types of experiments and research.
  
Organizes PMRC related events and conferences as needed to support scientific collaboration with PMRC users and affiliates.
  
Participates in the program budgeting and accounting processes to support a self supporting / sustaining financial infrastructure of the academic or research program.
  
Manages financial and HR Resources to assist with hiring, purchasing and procurement, and research staff and equipment management. Develop and implement procedures for managing research staff appointments, equipment needs, supply inventory and others as needed.
  
**Facilitates proposal submissions and reporting:** Assisting in preparation, submission, and collection of information for internal and external review. Collect and compile data for internal and external reports, such as progress reports for funding agencies. Maintain accurate records of research activities and outcomes for reporting purposes.
  
Oversees center internal and external communications including Center newsletter, social media, website, and printed materials. Draft press releases and other PR materials to promote research. Point of contact for public relations officers at PMRC institutions and other members of the media.
  
Identifies cost-saving measures and optimize resource allocation.
  
Is responsible for PMRC equipment maintenance, procurement, inventory, etc. Work with campus partners to manage space and equipment needs.
  
  
Financial/Extramural Management - 25%
  
  
Liaison to the College of Chemistry and Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory (LBNL) business services support units. Formulate annual operating budgets including spending projections. Audit and analyze financial reports and forecast expenses to ensure Principal Investigator (P.I.) meets financial obligations of the research group.
  
Integrate UCB and LBNL reports to create current and accurate comprehensive financial picture to ensure fiscal integrity. Anticipate and resolve operational, fiscal or other discrepancies. Work with both UCB and LBNL relevant personnel at the facility and in the central support offices to provide overall support to this function.
  
Oversee the post-award administration of grants, contracts, and agreements. Ensure the terms and conditions of all awards are met and manage funds in compliance with university, LBNL, DOE, federal, and state policies and regulations. Confer with Sponsored Project Office (SPO), UCB and LBNL service units on terms and conditions of awards, budget augmentation, project period, and award extension.
  
Ensure financial integrity of research funds by regularly reviewing expenditures and comparing to budget and ensuring funds are not in overdraft.
  
Advise research unit and P.I. on how funds can be used optimally. Analyze expenses, develop cost projections, and provide financial tracking to fulfill reporting requirements to agencies. This includes reviewing of blanket purchase orders and comparing tracking worksheets to general ledger postings. jobs.title: Office & Studio Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Office & Studio Operations Manager

Ironhorse Physical Therapy & Pilates | San Ramon, CA | On-site, full-time | Start date: as soon as possible

About the role

Ironhorse is a cash-pay physical therapy and Pilates practice in San Ramon. We are hiring a manager who owns how the practice runs day to day, so the owner can step out of operations. This is not a front-desk seat and not an admin seat. You will own a defined set of outcomes, track them with simple numbers, and fix the cause when something keeps dropping. You may come from boutique fitness, a Pilates or PT studio, a small healthcare practice, or another appointment-based service business. What matters is that you have owned results, led people and followed through.

What you will own

Five areas, each with you as the owner and a weekly number.

- Lead-to-booked-visit and client follow-through: every new inquiry answered fast and moved to a booked visit, no-show and late-cancel follow-up on every one, package renewals and reactivation, client questions and routine issues handled before they reach the owner.

- Scheduling and admin coordination: schedule accuracy and fill in Jane, client messages in Quo, check-in and check-out, the shared admin inbox answered and routed, unpaid balances and superbill paperwork chased to done.

- Owner and Pilates lead coordination: you keep the owner and the lead Pilates instructor aligned and unblocked. That means calendars and handoffs, follow-ups on open items from each of them, a weekly priorities list, and bringing decisions to them in writing so they are not chasing details.

- Staff and intern oversight: you supervise our interns and aides day to day, including schedules, training, task assignments, and timesheets. You also coordinate admin support and front-of-house team members, payroll prep for the twice-monthly run, new-hire paperwork and onboarding checklists. You raise performance issues with the owner with a recommendation.

- Systems: supplies, equipment and vendor or building issues resolved, and written SOPs kept current. You write them and you update them.

KPIs (starting targets, set with you in the first 30 days)

- Admin inbox and Quo messages answered within one business day.

- New-inquiry-to-booked-visit rate tracked weekly, with a follow-up on every lead that does not book.

- No-show and late-cancel rate tracked weekly, with a follow-up on every one.

- Timesheets complete and payroll data ready by the deadline every pay period.

- Intern and aide schedules filled and training checklists complete.

- Open client balances reviewed weekly, with a short written report.

- Every recurring task has a written SOP and a named owner.

- A one-page weekly update to the owner: what moved, what slipped, why, and the fix.

Your first 90 days

- Days 1-30: take over lead-to-booked-visit and client follow-through, and start the weekly priorities list for the owner and the lead Pilates instructor.

- Days 31-60: add scheduling and admin coverage, take over intern and aide oversight, and make routine scheduling reliable.

- Days 61-90: put the weekly scorecard and SOP upkeep in place, and show that fewer routine issues need the owner.

How the role works

Reports to Victoria Liu, owner. Works alongside Joyce (assistant/admin), the lead Pilates instructor, and the clinical team, with a weekly 30-minute review with the owner. You decide on routine scheduling, intern and aide assignments, client issues within agreed limits, supplies and admin process. Clinical decisions stay with clinicians. Hiring, firing, pay, pricing and major spending stay with the owner. Tools: Jane App, Quo, Slack, Google Workspace, QuickBooks (view and reconcile support), ADP (payroll data entry). Full-time, on-site in San Ramon. Practice hours run until 7pm, so some evening coverage is part of the schedule. Exact days to be agreed.

What we are looking for

- 2+ years leading a team or running an office, practice or studio, ideally in healthcare, fitness or another appointment-based business.

- Experience supervising or training junior staff, interns or students.

- A record of improving follow-through, retention or team reliability that you can describe with numbers.

- Strong client communication, and comfort with scheduling/EMR or CRM software (Jane App a plus) and basic billing.

- Calm, clear and organized. You close loops without being chased, and you know when to decide and when to ask.

- Comfortable with confidentiality: patient information (HIPAA) and staff pay.

- Preferred: experience writing SOPs or tracking KPIs. Pilates certification is not required.

Compensation and benefits

$60,000 per year, W-2, full-time.

- Medical stipend: $400 per month

- 401(k) with employer match up to 6%

- Profit sharing eligibility

How to apply

Email admin@ironhorsept.com with the subject "Office & Studio Operations Manager". Include your resume, your availability, and one example of a process you owned end to end and what improved. We would like to fill this role as soon as possible.

Ironhorse PT is an equal opportunity employer.

Pay: $60,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Requisition ID # 175130
  
  
**Job Category:** Project / Program Management
  
**Job Level:** Individual Contributor
  
**Business Unit:** Energy Delivery
  
**Work Type:** Hybrid
  
**Job Location:** Oakland; Pleasanton
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Electric Program Manager manages and/or administers a company program, a grouping of project work or a special customer offering with an assigned/designated annual financial budget. The incumbent provides oversight, governance, communication, training, reporting as well as overall process and project management for the assigned program. He / She manages the program budget, which may include developing and presenting the budget proposal.
  
  
This position is hybrid, working from your remote office and your assigned work location based on business need. The current expectation is to be in the office one to two days per week. The assigned work location will be within the PG&E Service Territory.
  
  
PG&E is providing the salary range that the company in good faith believes it might pay for this position at the time of the job posting. This compensation range is specific to the locality of the job. The actual salary paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, geographic location, collective bargaining agreements, and internal equity. Although we estimate the successful candidate hired into this role will be placed towards the middle or entry point of the range ($163,000) , the decision will be made on a case-by-case basis related to these factors. This job is also eligible to participate in PG&E’s discretionary incentive compensation programs.
  
  
**A reasonable salary range is:** Bay Area Minimum: $126,000 Bay Area Mid-Point: $163,000 Bay Area Maximum: $200,000
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
Applies expert knowledge of Program Management to wide-ranging issues and assignments. Works independently with guidance on only the most complex issues. May lead project teams. May design and develop new programs under a larger umbrella of goals and initiatives. Manages all aspects of programs that are cross departmental, complex and have a significant impact on the line of business. Leads development of plans to achieve program goals. Provides standardized regular reports, along with custom, ad-hoc reports for special projects. May supports divisions with reporting for operational metrics to provide intelligence on performance trends. Develops and delivers presentation to leaders regarding the program progress toward goals. Plans and forecasts work to be completed as part of the program. Monitors and ensures closure/completion of projects and/or other program maintenance & construction work orders. Identifies issues and develops solutions. Presents recommendations and implementation plan to leadership for approval. Performs trend analysis to identify cost drivers and develop and execute mitigation plans to improve business results. Manages capital and expense spending to ensure work identified in the program plan is completed and productivity cost targets are achieved. Reviews cost monitoring systems to ensure that adequate controls are in place to uncover and correct erroneous charges. negotiates and sets productivity and unit cost targets. Prepares accurate forecasts, monitors spending, and develops and presents variance explanations. Develops business case for budget and/or additional funding during the year. Works closely with peers and leaders in line of business to ensure financial targets are understood and achieved. Leads partner organizations to develop and implement improved processes, best practices, controls and procedures to improve efficiencies, compliance and customer satisfaction and reduce cost. May work with other project or program managers or peers in other departments or regions to reschedule work, re-allocate funds and explore other means to achieve financial and productivity goals. Represents the program as a subject matter expert and stakeholder on process improvement teams, regulatory filings, and various stakeholder groups. May support the GRC witness with testimony development and data request response support. May develop new policies and all relevant processes, infrastructure, documentation, tools, etc. to support a new program. Develops tools for tracking and control. Develops communication and training plans. Ensures target audience is fully educated in the purpose of the program and the proper processes and requirements to follow. Ensures compliance with the program. Ensures regulatory compliance with the program. May provide leadership or work direction to lower level peers.
  
  
Background Qualifications
  
  
Minimum
  
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience 7 years’ total related experience Experience managing capital expense budgets
  
  
Desired
  
PMP Certification In depth knowledge of electric utility processes, regulatory requirements, critical success factors, goals and initiatives. Team leadership and collaboration skills. General financial management & budgeting skills and business acumen. Strong communication, interpersonal, influence skills. Basic negotiation skills. Analytical problem solving and decision making ability Knowledge of project management, process improvement best practices, concepts, methods and techniques Strong organizational skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools Strong presentation skills May need knowledge of various enterprise resource planning (ERP) system modules

jobs.description:
**Sr. QA Engineer**

**Contract with a publicly traded company.**

**FTE with** **Purple Squirrels Software LLC**

Newark, CA — Onsite

**Mail resume to staffing@purple-squirrels.com**

**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain automated test suites (UI, API, integration) using AI-assisted tools to accelerate test-case generation, maintenance, and self-healing of flaky tests
* Own end-to-end QA for assigned feature areas — test planning, test-case design, exploratory testing, and regression coverage, not just automation
* Evaluate and integrate AI/ML-based testing tools (e.g., AI test-generation copilots, visual-regression AI, anomaly detection in test results) into the existing QA pipeline
* Triage, log, and track defects through resolution; collaborate directly with developers on root cause and fix verification
* Build and maintain CI/CD test integration so automated suites run reliably on every build
* Analyze test results and production signals to identify quality risk areas before they become customer-facing defects
* Mentor other QA engineers on applying AI tooling effectively without sacrificing test rigor

* 6–9 years of QA engineering experience, including at least 2+ years building and maintaining test automation frameworks (Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or equivalent)
* Hands-on experience using AI-assisted testing or development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, AI test-generation platforms) in a production QA workflow
* Strong scripting ability in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java for building and maintaining automated tests
* Experience with API testing (Postman, REST Assured, or similar) and CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI)

* Comfort using AI-enabled project management tools (e.g., Jira AI, Asana Intelligence) for sprint tracking and status reporting
* Able to work onsite in Newark, CA

**Preferred**

* QA experience in automotive, embedded systems, or another hardware-adjacent software environment
* Experience with performance and load testing tools

jobs.description:
Job Description: Operations Lead Position Summary

The Operations Lead is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the dispensary while ensuring compliance, exceptional customer service, and efficient store performance. This role serves as a key leader on the sales floor, managing opening and closing procedures, supporting team members, maintaining inventory accuracy, and ensuring all operational standards are met. The Operations Lead acts as a role model for the team and helps create a safe, compliant, and welcoming environment for both customers and employees. MUST BE 21+

Key Responsibilities - Store Operations

* Perform all opening and closing procedures, including securing the facility, cash reconciliation, and alarm activation/deactivation.
* Ensure the dispensary is clean, organized, fully stocked, and ready for business each day.
* Maintain operational excellence by following all company policies, SOPs, and state cannabis regulations.
* Monitor daily store performance and communicate operational updates to management.

Team Leadership

* Lead by example and provide guidance and support to budtenders and other team members throughout each shift.
* Delegate tasks and ensure daily responsibilities are completed efficiently.
* Assist with onboarding and training new employees on operational procedures and compliance standards.
* Foster a positive, professional, and customer-focused work environment.

Customer Experience

* Deliver exceptional customer service and assist with resolving customer concerns in a timely and professional manner.
* Support sales goals by ensuring team members provide knowledgeable product recommendations and maintain a positive shopping experience.
* Step in to assist during high-volume periods and ensure smooth customer flow.

Inventory & Compliance

* Assist with inventory counts, product receiving, restocking, and inventory reconciliation.
* Verify all cannabis products are properly labeled, stored, and tracked according to state regulations.
* Ensure all compliance requirements are followed, including age verification, ID checks, and accurate point-of-sale transactions.
* Report inventory discrepancies or compliance concerns to management immediately.

Cash Handling

* Perform register audits and cash drawer counts.
* Prepare deposits and complete end-of-day cash reconciliation.
* Maintain accountability for cash handling procedures and minimize discrepancies.

Qualifications

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Previous leadership experience in retail, hospitality, or cannabis preferred.
* Knowledge of cannabis products and applicable state regulations is preferred.
* Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail.
* Must be able to work flexible schedules, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
* Must meet all state requirements for employment in a licensed cannabis dispensary.
* Will Need to Pass Criminal Background Check

Physical Requirements

* Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
* Ability to lift and carry up to 40 pounds.
* Frequent bending, reaching, and stocking of merchandise.

Key Competencies

* Leadership and accountability
* Operational excellence
* Customer service
* Inventory management
* Cash handling accuracy
* Regulatory compliance
* Communication and teamwork
* Time management
* Problem-solving
* Attention to detail

Pay Range $20-$23 Depending on Experience + PLUS TIPS

Pay: $20.00 - $23.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

jobs.title: Security Operations Team Lead
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE
  
  
Come join the company at the center of how the world adopts AI securely. Cyera’s mission is to give enterprises the confidence to embrace AI safely — deciding exactly what it can see and do as it reaches deeper into the business. We started by solving the hardest problem in data security: finding and securing data faster and more precisely than anyone thought possible. That foundation is now the essential AI trust infrastructure for the Fortune 1000. We’re hiring mission-driven talent to put those leaders at the center of our story.
  
  
THE OPPORTUNITY
  
  
Join our team as the Security Operations Team Lead. You will lead a team of Security Operations Engineers, serve as incident commander for major incidents, and own the day-to-day health and improvement of our agentic SOC.
  
  
You will also run our customer zero program, in which we operate the Cyera platform on our own environment and feed what we learn back to Product. This is a player-coach role: you lead the team and stay hands-on.
  
  
The ideal candidate has 5 or more years in security operations or incident response, including senior or lead-level experience, has run significant incidents end to end, and has led or mentored engineers.
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**  
**Team Leadership:** Lead, coach, and develop the Security Operations team; set priorities, run the operational cadence, and build career paths.

**Requirements:**

**Technical Depth:** Strong Python and detection engineering across SIEM and cloud telemetry; able to review and improve others' work.
  
**Operating Discipline:** Experience defining metrics, running an operational cadence, and reporting to leadership.
  
**Communication:** Clear with executives and engineers; calm and decisive under pressure.

**Regulated Environments:** FedRAMP, SOC 2, or ISO 27001.
  
**Certifications:** GCIH, GCFA, CISSP, AWS Security Specialty, or similar.

jobs.title: Health Coach
jobs.description:
**About Us:**

Future is building a personalized guidance system for lifelong health. We help people understand what to do next for their body, goals, and stage of life — then support them in turning those decisions into sustained behavior change. By combining AI, human expertise, personal health data, and accountability, Future helps members improve performance today while building the resilience, capacity, and healthspan they need for decades to come.

**Who We Are**
--------------

Future pairs each member with an expert coach who gets to know them, their goals, and their data, then builds a healthier life around all of it. We started in fitness, and we're now going further: a coaching-led health experience that brings together movement, nutrition, sleep and recovery, and leverages real clinical data to build precise, custom member protocols. Our offering is continuing to evolve and we're looking for coaches who want to help shape it.

**About the Role**
------------------

Role Type: 1099 (independent contractor) Full-time

As a Health Coach, you'll own a caseload of members and guide each of them from their first day through their progress milestones. This is a partner role, not a prescriber role: you draw out what a member actually wants, meet them where they are, and help them build habits that last across nutrition, movement, sleep, and stress. You'll coach through a mix of virtual face-to-face sessions and day-to-day messaging, and you'll use each member's data to make your guidance specific and personal. The members we serve expect high-touch, polished care, with the coach at the center of their experience.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Own your members' experience end to end.** Guide a caseload of members from onboarding through their 90-day milestone and beyond, and keep every one of them feeling individually known.
* **Coach live and asynchronously.** Run virtual kickoff and check-in sessions, and support members between sessions over messaging that stays warm, timely, and clear.
* **Build personalized, data-informed plans.** With the support of AI tooling, translate each member's goals and data into a plan across fitness, nutrition, sleep, and recovery, and adjust it as their life and results change.
* **Coach the person, not just the plan.** Use motivational interviewing and reflective listening to help members find their own reasons for change and choose their own next step, rather than handing them a prescription.
* **Make the data useful.** Under the guidance of Future’s Clinical Team, contextualize body composition scans, bloodwork and GLP-1 considerations within your scope, and turn them into everyday actions a member can take.
* **Make progress visible.** Track progress against goals your members helped set, and celebrate the behavior and consistency wins, not just the number on a scan.
* **Help build.** Bring what you learn from members back to the team, and help us shape a program that's ever growing and evolving.

**Who you are**
---------------

* **Empathetic.** You lead with care and meet people where they are, whether it's a member having a hard week or a teammate under pressure.
* **Independent, and collaborative.** You can run your caseload at a high level without hand-holding, and you still genuinely enjoy working alongside your teammates.
* **An active part of the community.** Even though we're a virtual company, you show up: you join calls, contribute to projects, and share honest feedback that makes the team better.
* **Proactive.** You chase down answers, follow up, and take initiative instead of waiting to be told.
* **Tech-savvy.** You pick up new tools quickly and are comfortable working across apps, data, and platforms all day.

**What you'll need**
--------------------

**Required (non-negotiable)**

* **NBC-HWC (National Board Certified Health & Wellness Coach) —** full board certification through the National Board for Health & Wellness Coaching is required. This is our core standard for behavior-change theory, motivational interviewing, reflective listening, and coaching scope of practice.
* **An associate's degree or higher** (or an equivalent, experience-based path to your coaching certification).
* **2+ years of client-facing coaching or training experience.** Enough that you can run a member session on day one, without a ramp.
* **Proven high-volume caseload management.** You've personally carried a large book of clients at once and kept each of them feeling individually known.
* **Comfort working with a diverse member population.** You adapt your style to meet members of different ages, backgrounds, cultures, abilities, and health starting points, and every one of them feels respected and understood.
* **Strong written communication.** Much of your coaching happens over messaging, so you're warm, clear, and personable on the page while staying professional.
* **Strong verbal communication and presence.** You also coach face-to-face over video, and you bring confidence, thoughtfulness and professionalism into every session.
* **Comfortable synthesizing health data.** You keep up with current health trends and have a track record of coaching clients across nutrition apps and wearable devices, bringing their data together into a single comprehensive plan.

**Strong plus (not required)**

* **Additional coaching credentials layered on top of NBC-HWC,** such as ACE Health Coach, Precision Nutrition L1, or NASM Behavior Change Specialist.
* **A personal-training or strength credential** (CSCS; NASM, ACE, or ACSM CPT; or similar).
* **A nutrition-coaching certification** such as Precision Nutrition.
* **An advanced degree** in exercise science, physiology, kinesiology, or a related field.
* **Clinical collaboration in functional or integrative medicine.** You've worked alongside or under registered dietitians, nurse practitioners, or physicians.
* **Experience with luxury clientele.** You've served high-end members in concierge medic

Job Description: Operations Lead Position Summary

The Operations Lead is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the dispensary while ensuring compliance, exceptional customer service, and efficient store performance. This role serves as a key leader on the sales floor, managing opening and closing procedures, supporting team members, maintaining inventory accuracy, and ensuring all operational standards are met. The Operations Lead acts as a role model for the team and helps create a safe, compliant, and welcoming environment for both customers and employees. MUST BE 21+

Key Responsibilities - Store Operations

* Perform all opening and closing procedures, including securing the facility, cash reconciliation, and alarm activation/deactivation.
* Ensure the dispensary is clean, organized, fully stocked, and ready for business each day.
* Maintain operational excellence by following all company policies, SOPs, and state cannabis regulations.
* Monitor daily store performance and communicate operational updates to management.

Team Leadership

* Lead by example and provide guidance and support to budtenders and other team members throughout each shift.
* Delegate tasks and ensure daily responsibilities are completed efficiently.
* Assist with onboarding and training new employees on operational procedures and compliance standards.
* Foster a positive, professional, and customer-focused work environment.

Customer Experience

* Deliver exceptional customer service and assist with resolving customer concerns in a timely and professional manner.
* Support sales goals by ensuring team members provide knowledgeable product recommendations and maintain a positive shopping experience.
* Step in to assist during high-volume periods and ensure smooth customer flow.

Inventory & Compliance

* Assist with inventory counts, product receiving, restocking, and inventory reconciliation.
* Verify all cannabis products are properly labeled, stored, and tracked according to state regulations.
* Ensure all compliance requirements are followed, including age verification, ID checks, and accurate point-of-sale transactions.
* Report inventory discrepancies or compliance concerns to management immediately.

Cash Handling

* Perform register audits and cash drawer counts.
* Prepare deposits and complete end-of-day cash reconciliation.
* Maintain accountability for cash handling procedures and minimize discrepancies.

Qualifications

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Previous leadership experience in retail, hospitality, or cannabis preferred.
* Knowledge of cannabis products and applicable state regulations is preferred.
* Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail.
* Must be able to work flexible schedules, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
* Must meet all state requirements for employment in a licensed cannabis dispensary.
* Will Need to Pass Criminal Background Check

Physical Requirements

* Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
* Ability to lift and carry up to 40 pounds.
* Frequent bending, reaching, and stocking of merchandise.

Key Competencies

* Leadership and accountability
* Operational excellence
* Customer service
* Inventory management
* Cash handling accuracy
* Regulatory compliance
* Communication and teamwork
* Time management
* Problem-solving
* Attention to detail

Pay Range $20-$23 Depending on Experience + PLUS TIPS

Pay: $20.00 - $23.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person
